title: Optimization of therapeutic antibodies by predicting antigen specificity from antibody sequence via deep learning
summary: Neural networks trained on about 10^4 trastuzumab variants screened for HER2 specificity were used to screen about 10^8 computational variants and identify optimised HER2-specific variants.
ai_technology: Deep neural networks trained on antibody-library deep-sequencing/screening data

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Abstract reports prediction-led identification of variants; downstream validation details not assessed.
evidence.unknown: Developability and clinical relevance not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted antigen specificity from sequence to select optimised variants.
